name: WPC Cart Item Note for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC Cart Item Note is a lightweight and useful plugin for WooCommerce that allows buyers to easily add notes or special instructions for individual products directly on the cart page.

Whether customers need to specify packaging preferences, provide gift messages, or add any other specific requests for a particular item, this plugin makes it simple and intuitive. The notes are saved instantly using AJAX, ensuring a seamless shopping experience without page reloads.

These notes will be carried over to the checkout page and saved as order item meta data, making them visible to both the shop administrator (in the WooCommerce Orders dashboard) and the customer (in order completion emails and their account dashboard).

Features

  • Add, edit, or remove notes for individual products on the cart page.
  • AJAX-powered interactions (no page reloads required when saving/deleting notes).
  • Notes are displayed clearly under the product name in both the Cart and Checkout pages.
  • Notes are saved securely as order item meta data.
  • Lightweight, highly optimized, and works seamlessly with standard WooCommerce themes.
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly design.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and choose the downloaded .zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. The plugin works out of the box. Go to your store frontend, add a product to the cart, and you will see the “Add Note” option below the item name on the Cart page.
sections.faq:
Where do the notes appear in the backend?

Once an order is placed, the notes will appear as “Item Meta” (custom fields) attached to each specific product within the WooCommerce Order details page.

Does it reload the page when a note is saved?

No. WPC Cart Item Note uses AJAX to instantly save and update the note in the cart session without refreshing the page.
